Registration in coord_team_tools.rs, optional_tools.rs, and agent_acp_tools.rs uses tools.insert (no reg( helper) and is recognized by NO census shape — a fifth registration shape the guard is blind to, exactly the failure the module doc records repeatedly ('the question is never whether the rule is right, it is how many registration shapes the guard recognises'). proposed_change: Either (a) add a fifth census table + guard (e.g. NON_CORE_REGISTRY_DESCRIPTIONS) that include_str!-scans coord_team_tools.rs / optional_tools.rs / agent_acp_tools.rs for tools.insert("name" sites and asserts parity, folding their bytes into CATALOG_DESCRIPTION_CEILING_BYTES; or (b) explicitly acknowledge the gap in the ceiling doc and decide these families are acceptable to leave unmeasured. risk: No runtime or security impact today — the tools work and are advertised.
